TABLE.NAME: local_edqscore_course_settings
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course overrides of the My GAMA grading-turnaround thresholds

FIELD.NAME: showungraded
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0 = hide, 1 = show

FIELD.NAME: onlyshowsubmitted
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0 = show everyone, 1 = only show submitted work. Forced to 0 when assigncountfrom is not 'submission'.

FIELD.NAME: quizgradinghours
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default. Only applies to quizzes containing essay questions.

FIELD.NAME: quizonlymanual
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0 = show all quizzes, 1 = only show quizzes with a manually-graded (essay) question

FIELD.NAME: edqincludefeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0/1 = exclude/include assignment feedback in the EdQ score

FIELD.NAME: edqincludequizmanual
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0/1 = exclude/include manually graded quizzes in the EdQ score

FIELD.NAME: assignlatehours
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default. Hours past assigngradinghours before an assignment is 'Overdue' rather than merely 'Late'.

FIELD.NAME: forumlatehours
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default. Hours past forumgradinghours before a forum item is 'Overdue' rather than merely 'Late'.

FIELD.NAME: quizlatehours
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default. Hours past quizgradinghours before a quiz is 'Overdue' rather than merely 'Late'.

FIELD.NAME: edqscoredigestenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0 = never send the daily EdQ Score digest for this course, 1 = send it

FIELD.NAME: submissiondigestenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = use the site-wide default, 0 = never send the daily submission digest for this course, 1 = send it
